en: Vintage portrait postcard featuring a seated military officer in formal uniform framed within a rectangular vignette. To the left stands a tall flagpole bearing an early Greek flag with horizontal light and dark stripes and a small canton with a crown. The background is plain and tinted in sepia tones. Printed French text beneath the portrait identifies the person as a royal prince of Greece, and there is handwritten script along the upper edge.
